en.dr-ali-peiravi: 1-14 Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyih - may God be pleased with him - narrated that his uncle Muhammad ibn Abil-Qasim quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Aba Abdullah al-Barqy, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers, on the authority of Ali (MGB), “
True prosperity is that man’s deeds result in his prosperity and that true misery is that man’s deeds result in his misery.”
